claims.text: The as-reported HfNbTiVAl10 material has a hierarchical heterostructure.
The hierarchical heterostructure is the structural mediator relevant to the proposed predictive improvement.
A new interatomic potential can be tailored specifically to HfNbTiVAl10 hierarchical heterostructures.
The tailored potential will improve prediction of Young's modulus by at least 15% relative to established simulations under tensile and fracture testing conditions.
The tailored potential will improve prediction of yield strength by at least 15% relative to established simulations under tensile and fracture testing conditions.
The tailored potential will improve prediction of fracture-related behavior by at least 15% relative to established simulations under tensile and fracture testing conditions.
Novel interatomic-potential methods can improve computational efficiency while retaining or improving predictive accuracy.
The magnitude of the predictive improvement may vary with tensile and fracture testing conditions.
The magnitude of the predictive improvement may vary with the quality of the new interatomic potential.
An improvement of less than 10% is declared to falsify the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis predicts at least a 15% improvement, but the predeclared rule falsifies it only below 10%. A measured improvement from 10% to less than 15% would violate the stated prediction without satisfying the stated falsification rule.
